versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill overview file (skill-card.md).
- Updated runtime/run.mjs; details not specified.
- No feature or workflow changes in SKILL.md.
- Documentation and functionality remain consistent with the previous version.

- Updated runtime guide and implementation files for improved documentation and process clarity.
- Refined internal workflow and error handling within runtime scripts.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file for a leaner repository.

- Initial release of yaps-transcription skill.
- Converts audio or video files into text transcriptions using Yaps (v2.3.124+ required).
- Produces plain text transcripts; rejects files with blank speech or partial decodes.
- Handles file paths securely; uses temporary JSON request files for operations.
- Subtitles and speaker label support available when requested and properly configured.
- No cloud transcription fallback; all processing is local.
